name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. While running a successful engineering firm specializing in automotive components, a chance encounter with a struggling Formula 3 team ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. He initially offered technical consultancy, but his sharp eye for detail and ability to identify and resolve bottlenecks quickly led to him taking on a more significant role. He prides himself on fostering a collaborative and data-driven environment, where every team member's input is valued and analyzed.

His management style is characterized by a pragmatic approach, balancing calculated risks with a commitment to long-term sustainability. While he may not be the most flamboyant team principal, Park's meticulous planning and dedication to continuous improvement have consistently yielded results. He believes in empowering his staff, providing them with the resources and support needed to excel, and holding them accountable for their performance. His engineering background ensures he understands the technical intricacies of the sport, allowing him to make informed decisions under pressure. 

Park is distinguished by his ability to see the bigger picture and to adapt quickly to changing circumstances. He has a knack for identifying talent and nurturing it, and he is always looking for ways to improve the team's performance, both on and off the track. He believes in the power of teamwork and is committed to creating a positive and productive work environment. MP Motorsport is his life's work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a side part
physical.description: A distinguished man with a composed demeanor, Park carries himself with an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations during races.
Has a fondness for strong black coffee, consuming several cups throughout the day.
Insists on personally inspecting every car after each session, looking for potential issues.
